name: Hobbywing QuicRun 1060 ESC + 540 brushed motor
description: Brushed ESC with a stock-class 540/550 motor, modelled as one drive unit. The BEC powers the steering servo.

pins.name: SIGNAL
pins.description: Throttle pulses on the receiver lead; 3.3 V logic is enough.

pins.name: BEC
pins.description: Switch-mode BEC on the receiver lead. 6 V: do not power the controller or 3.3 V sensors from it.

notes: Published (Hobbywing): 2-3S LiPo (6.0-12.6 V); 60 A continuous / 360 A peak forward; BEC 6 V / 3 A switch mode; 540/550 motors >= 12T or < 30000 rpm at 7.2 V on 2S; arming: hold neutral at power-on and wait 3 s; default mode forward/brake/reverse (reverse needs a double-tap, modelled in physics stage 2); ESC 39 g, 36.5 x 32 x 18 mm. The ESC ships set to NiMH; set the LiPo jumper on the real car. Estimates: pulse range 1000/1500/2000 us (the ESC auto-calibrates to what it sees); deadband +-40 us (not published, not adjustable); typical current 5 A cruising, peak 60 A (the continuous rating). Motor: mass 240 g (Traxxas Titan 12T 550, the Slash stock motor); Kv 2700 rpm/V and 0.2 N.m stall torque at 7.4 V are typical stock-motor figures, not published (no 7.2 V 540 datasheet is available).
